title: crinum ornatum subvar. acutior
intro: Crinum ornatum subvar. acutior, commonly known as the Dragon's Eye, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing fever and relieving respiratory issues. Research on the plant has shown its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, antitumor, and antiviral activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and saponins. However, more studies are needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Crinum ornatum subvar. acutior for medicinal purposes.
